propositions: Comment sync currently identifies comments by normalized body text, causing collisions when identical comments are created and treating edits as new comments instead of skipping them

Comment identity must be refactored from body-equality to a persistent map of local HLC timestamp keys to Jira comment IDs, with separate authoritative identity stores for inbound (jira_comment_id) and outbound (map) directions

The returned add_comment API response dict containing the Jira comment ID is currently discarded at both enactment sites (create_one and update_one via _update_one_dispatch_comments) and must be captured and persisted with write-ahead durability

Outbound comment bodies must render through RichTextCodec.to_wire with fit-then-encode ordering (fit plaintext first, then JSON-serialize for ADF), and the _resolve_codec injection must migrate from _IdentityCodec to the real codec to keep dedup keys convergent with rendered wire form

The append-only semantics require outbound skip logic to be gated on mapped HLC key OR jira_comment_id presence as the primary guard, with normalized-body equality demoted to a secondary fallback, while inbound differ remains unchanged
A lost map write after successful add_comment must not cause re-posting on the next reconcile pass, enforced by immediate save() on record_comment_id and the demoted body-equality secondary skip
